answer: Social Matters >> Food & Drinks Question ID: 42722 Country: BH Title: Are those chickens halal on which it is written that "slaughtered by hand according to Islamic rite? Question: Are those chickens halal on which it is written that "slaughtered by hand according to Islamic rite? Answer ID: 42722 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1715/1715/M=1433) If the chickens come from such an area where most of the population belongs to kuffar or such Ahl Kitab (People of Book) who do not slaughter as per the Shariah then it is not enough to write halal on the zabiha [slaughtered animal]. If it is known surely that it has been slaughtered as per the Shariah then it shall be halal; otherwise one should avoid eating it. But if it comes from Muslim area then it can be consumed. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
